text:
Evan (PM): short thread 1: need final copy + a11y checks for the 'Focus failing tests' toggle and undo snackbar. keeping compact view default for power users.
Mina (Design): UI proposal: header toggle 'Show: All | Failing only' with small persisted state icon. compact rows show first-line diff + quick-expand chevron.
Jordan (Product): Important microcopy: bulk approve tooltip should read 'Approve visible tests (filtered) — updates baselines'. call out filter context.
Lee (Eng): backend will take current filter+page to compute IDs. we'll return optimistic success and run background job. add data-qa=bulk-approve, data-qa=undo-snackbar.
Zara (A11y): a11y: the toggle should be role=switch + aria-checked and announce state changes in a polite live region: 'Filter set to failing only'. Avoid focus jumps when list updates.
Mina (Design): undo snackbar copy suggestion: 'Baselines updated for 8 tests. Undo' with a visible button. keep it non-modal and do not steal focus.
Evan (PM): timeframe: 10-minute undo window. show a small countdown in the snackbar only visually, not required by SR.
Lee (Eng): we'll expose an undo endpoint and telemetry approve_type=bulk|inline. also will set aria-live=polite on the progress indicator in header so SRs get status updates.
Zara (A11y): snackbar must use role=status and be dismissible. ensure color+icon are not sole indicators; include text 'Approved' and count. keyboard focus should remain in main flow; undo button must be reachable by keyboard.
Jordan (Product): microcopy variant to A/B test: short 'Approve visible tests (8) — updates baselines' vs longer 'Approve visible tests (8) and update baselines (undo available for 10 minutes)'.
Mina (Design): I'll add both variants to Figma and include expanded state where an inline diff sample is shown in the modal confirm.
infra-bot: baseline job for run 1203 queued 9 ETA ~30s.
Evan (PM): OK next steps: Mina update mocks with toggle + snackbar states, Lee add data-qa and undo API, Zara will validate SR flow after mocks. target: review by EOD Thursday.
